name: Fervor Coupon
desc: A type of coupon widely circulated among both the adventurers and the Mutual Aid Advancement Network. They can be exchanged to draw for limited-edition "Lady Katheryne" statue parts. Come to think of it... is Katheryne's popularity among adventurers and civilians actually completely off the charts?

value.text: Obtained from "Mutual Aid in Bloom: Into the Frostlands"
